title: Reservation Reminder for East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course
description: 96 Confirmation# 426720042 Hi Esther Scott , Your reservation is tomorrow at 8:40 am. East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course Sunday, July 26, 2026 8:40 am 2 Player(s) A Note from National Links Trust: We are devastated to share that the Trump administration has terminated National Links Trust’s lease, effective immediately. In the short term, NLT has agreed to stay on as operators, allowing our courses to remain open and our hundreds of dedicated employees to stay in place. However, the future of affordable, accessible, high-quality public golf in the District is bleak. This is not the update we wanted to share. As a DC golfer, you know how special the East Potomac, Langston, and Rock Creek courses are. While this termination is a major setback, we remain stubbornly hopeful that a path forward can be found that preserves affordable and accessible public golf in the nation’s capital for generations to come. PlayDCgolf and NLT remain fully committed to honoring the legacies and principles of DC’s historic public courses. We hope that you stand with us and continue to share your love of DC public golf with friends, family, and beyond. Tee Time Cancellation Policy: Please log into the tee time booking portal at least 2 hours in advance to cancel or reduce the number of players to your tee time. Questions about your reservation? Call us at (202) 554-7660. Book Next Round Visit Our Website East Potomac Golf Links - RED Course 972 Ohio Dr SW, Washington, DC 20024, US (202) 554-7660 TM

Caption: All-Star MVP Jonquell Jones notched a near triple-double to lift Team Spoon over Team Coop on Saturday. (JWS)

**New York’s Jonquel Jones stood tall on Saturday,** lifting the 2026 WNBA All-Star Game [MVP trophy](https://www.instagram.com/p/DbPbUWOvjpe/) after leading Team Spoon to a 129-122 win over Team Coop.

* The Liberty big pulled off the league’s first [MVP sweep](https://x.com/WNBA/status/2081220744143421767), after earning 2021 WNBA MVP, 2024 Finals MVP, 2023 Commissioner’s Cup MVP, and 2026 All-Star MVP.
